warnings.message: frontend: npm: npx, npm exec and npm x pick the version of a package they download with the release-age delay alone and do not read min-release-age-exclude, so they still hold new versions of @acme/* back for cooldown.minimum
warnings.fix: Install such a package with npm install, which reads min-release-age-exclude, and run it from node_modules/.bin: npx runs it from there without downloading it

warnings.message: backend: uv: exclude-newer-package does not support the pattern "acme-*"; not written
warnings.fix: List the exact package names in cooldown.exclude

warnings.message: backend: uv has no setting for git dependencies, so "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports such dependencies in the lockfile

warnings.message: backend: uv has no setting for URL dependencies, so "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports such dependencies in the lockfile

warnings.message: backend: uv: backend/uv.lock records exclude-newer, so it is out of date after this change
warnings.fix: Run uv lock and commit backend/uv.lock; until then uv sync --locked and uv lock --check fail
